data.notes: Warranty: 12 months from documented handover for supplied goods; workmanship support for 90 days. Synthetic test terms only.
data.terms: Quotation valid for 30 days. Confirm quantities before ordering. Delivery follows written acceptance. Installation requires site access and an isolated work area. Payment: 50% on acceptance and balance after testing. Exclusions: civil work and third-party approvals. No real supply or contractual offer is created by this synthetic test.
